newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts to head for 109-13 and beyond.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts to head for 109-13 and beyond.

text.p: June long gilt futures are looking positive and have scope to travel to 109-13 and further, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
"The contract is looking OK while it is above 108-29," said David Wood, independent technical analyst near London.
"It should be better on the back of T-bonds overnight, and can get to the old low on the hourly charts at 109-13.
"If we can get some real momentum going, we can get to 109-22/25," he added.
The gilt future opened at 109-09, 7/32 above Monday's closing price.
The contract reached a low of 109-13 on hourly charts on April 23.
Guenter Redeker, technical analyst at Chase in London, also found resistance for the contract at 109-13.
"Bullish momentum will be increased on a daily closing price above the 109-13 trendline resistance intervening on daily charts," he said in a note to clients.

Next stop at the area between 109-22, the high on April 24, and 109-25, the high on both April 21 and 23, is only possible if U.S. bonds continue to perform strongly over Tuesday's session, Wood said.
The opening move above 109-07 offers upside potential to 109-25, Redeker said.
The contract has a positive tone if it remains above 108-29 on Tuesday, Wood said. June gilts broke higher through that level on Monday. "We start to look shaky below 108-29."
June short sterling was one basis point higher at 93.34 at 0718 GMT.

"The June contract has hovered around main uptrend support running above 93.30. A rebound would be normal, but a close below 93.30 could trigger a further selling wave," said a European bank in a technical note to clients.
